args:
set -eu
WHEEL=/runtime/pyrosetta-bindcraft/pyrosetta-2026.29+releasequarterly.80a0635615-cp310-cp310-linux_x86_64.whl
TARGET=/runtime/pyrosetta-bindcraft/site-packages
python -V
rm -rf "$TARGET.partial"
mkdir -p "$TARGET.partial"
# --no-index/--no-deps: the licensed wheel is installed from the mounted
# tenant-private volume only; nothing is resolved from an index.
pip install --no-index --no-deps --disable-pip-version-check \
  --target "$TARGET.partial" "$WHEEL"
rm -rf "$TARGET"
mv "$TARGET.partial" "$TARGET"
PYTHONPATH="$TARGET" python -c "
import importlib.metadata as md
print('installed_version=' + md.version('pyrosetta'))
print('install_root_on_volume=true')
"
du -sh "$TARGET" | awk '{print "installed_tree_size="$1}'
echo INSTALL_COMPLETE
